pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Start the next roadmap stage in a separate research-only branch while PR #159 remains frozen pending its physical reviewer gate.

This PR defines the Stage Research boundary for **General computer-use coverage / Broad real-application physical coverage**.

## Decision

**NARROW — qualification architecture only**

First slice:

- keep existing CAP Browser + Windows/Desktop capability owners;
- define a finite, versioned cross-application acceptance matrix;
- add deterministic L1/L2 qualification contracts/fixtures before target-machine L3;
- introduce no new public semantic tool or consequence authority;
- adopt a new provider only after a reproduced matrix gap and fresh research re-entry.

## Reuse-first findings

- Playwright remains the accepted Browser default.
- Project UIA/Win32/DesktopState remains the Windows default.
- UFO/UFO² is limited to selective UIA/Win32/WinCOM/application mechanics; its planner/AgentOS hierarchy is rejected.
- FlaUI remains a focused UIA-wrapper candidate only for a measured gap.
- BrowserSkill remains tracked through PR #161 for authenticated Chromium and is not a prerequisite for the first broad matrix.
- OpenAdapt stays in the following external-procedure roadmap stage.
- Microsoft `winapp ui` is a real UI Automation CLI/library. Its app-name targeting can choose the wrong window for CAP; retain the current Windows route and re-evaluate WinApp only for a measured gap.
- Notepad, Electron, Office and file-dialog product tasks lack a current ordinary-Chat desktop mutation route; a new fixed procedure would need its own authority research and qualification even with six public tools.

## Current hosted check

At `893ccd0`, [Windows CI](https://github.com/BogdanAIP/chat-agent-platform/actions/runs/36168472340) failed twice in two different pre-existing Python tests: browser fixture readiness on attempt 1 and Temporary Chat send requalification on attempt 2. This PR changes only the research Markdown; the prior head `9e0090c` passed CI. The two failures are recorded, not counted as green or attributed to this document without evidence.

## Scope

Research/documentation only in this PR. No runtime/provider/public-tool/authority change.

PR #159 still owns the reviewer migration and must complete its exact-head independent review + target-Windows physical reviewer qualification separately before merge/acceptance claims.
